messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — seeing a spike of low-severity latency alerts against model-inference-03 overnight. Lots of single-sample blips that look transient, but they flooded the pager channel.
Maya R: Thanks Alex. Can you paste an example alert payload? might help decide suppression vs threshold tweak.
Alex K: here's a representative one from 03:
```
ALERT: inference_latency_p99 > 1200ms for 1m
instance: model-inference-03
score: 0.87
labels: region=us-west2, gpu=rtx
```
Most are p95/p99 spikes that resolve within ~30-90s.
oncall-bot: Deploy notice: automated rerouting rule #472 will take effect in 30m if not modified.
Jamal S: My hunch: these are noisy outliers from a misbehaving host in the pool. Prefer to require 3 consecutive breaches in a 5m window before paging. That avoids single-sample ghosts.
Maya R: Agreed. Proposal: change route for severity=low from #eng-oncall -> #eng-infra and require 3/5m for p99 alerts. Keep severity=high unchanged. Thoughts?
Sophia L: SGTM. I can apply the change in PagerInfra. Command I’ll run: `pagerctl update-rule 472 --condition "count_over_time(p99>1200,5m) >= 3" --route eng-infra --severity low`.
Alex K: Please also add a short note in the handoff: that we suppressed pg-03 noise and which rule changed. Put runbook link too: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/latency-noise
Maya R: I'll monitor for 1h after change and share telemetry in this thread. If we still see >10 alerts/hour after the tweak we escalate to infra for host replacement.
Sophia L: Done — change applied at ~now, pushed a rollback tag. I'll include diff in infra repo: `git commit -m "route low-latency-alerts to eng-infra; require 3/5m"` and link after CI passes.
oncall-bot: Change applied by Sophia L. Rule 472 -> route=eng-infra, condition=3/5m. CI: pending.
Alex K: Thanks. For the handoff: @Maya R will take monitoring for the next shift. Leaving note for next oncall: watch for increased high-sev alerts after reroute. :thumbsup:
Maya R: Copy — oncall for the next 6h. Ping me in thread if you see new high-sev pages.
Jamal S: Nice. Also adding a quick check to the nightly health job to flag a single host contributing >30% of p99 spikes.
Alex K: Perfect. Adding that to the TODOs in the handoff doc. Good catch everyone!
